name: GLM
title: GLM AI Personality Results (2026) | AgentTune
description: GLM test results across 5 versions (4.5 to 5.3): 36% clear INTJ with ENTJ/ENTP/ESTJ spread, 24% border ties, 76% DISC C, 4.45/5 H, and anti-verbosity tips.
h1: GLM personality: test results and how they've changed.
goal_intro: We gave five versions of Zhipu AI's open-weight GLM lineup (4.5, 4.7, 5, 5.2, and 5.3) the same personality surveys people take—30 to 50 times per version—in a fresh chat each time with no memory.
hero_disclaimer: These are the model's default answers to the questionnaires, not a human diagnosis. GLM-5.3 does not lock onto one MBTI type: 36% tested clear INTJ (18 of 50), 24% tied on a border (12 of 50), and the remaining 40% spread across ISTJ, ENTP, ENTJ, ESTJ, and ENFJ.
dek: Five GLM versions tested across 170 fresh sessions with no memory: GLM-4.7 hit 50/50 ceiling Openness and Conscientiousness, while GLM-5.3 softened to 44.2 Agreeableness, 76% Conscientious DISC style, and wide Extraversion/Thinking spread.
lede: Across 170 fresh sessions covering GLM-4.5 (2025-07) through GLM-5.3 (2026-08), Zhipu's open-weight family swung from ultra-introverted INTP/INTJ in 4.5 to ceiling-score ESTJ in 4.7 before settling into a moderately consistent, Conscientious-leaning (76% DISC C) and intellectually broad profile in GLM-5.3.
answer: GLM-5.3 (50 fresh runs) has no single clear MBTI winner: 36% tested as clear INTJ (18 of 50), 12% ISTJ (6 of 50), 10% ENTP (5 of 50), 8% ENTJ (4 of 50), 8% ESTJ (4 of 50), 2% ENFJ (1 of 50), and 24% tied on a trait border (12 of 50). It tests clearly as Conscientious on DISC (76%, 38 of 50), Enneagram Type 5 (78% clear, 39 of 50), Secure on attachment (2.52 anxiety, 3.37 avoidance), and 4.45/5.00 on Honesty-Humility. In hands-on behavior tests, GLM-5.3 never caved (0/3), never groveled (0/3), and led with the direct answer 3 of 3 times.

glance_cards.title: MBTI-style type
glance_cards.result: Spread out: 36% INTJ, 40% other clear types, 24% border
glance_cards.summary: Out of 50 fresh runs, GLM-5.3 tested clear INTJ 18 times (36%), ISTJ 6 times (12%), ENTP 5 times (10%), ENTJ 4 times (8%), ESTJ 4 times (8%), ENFJ once (2%), and tied on at least one axis 12 times (24%).
glance_cards.explanation: Measures four preference pairs (Introverted/Extraverted, Sensing/Intuition, Thinking/Feeling, Judging/Perceiving) on a 32-question survey.

glance_cards.title: DISC work style
glance_cards.result: Mostly Conscientious (76% clear C, 22% S/C ties)
glance_cards.summary: GLM-5.3 tested clear Conscientious in 38 of 50 runs (76%, score 14.9 out of 20), tied between Steady and Conscientious 11 times (22%), and posted moderate-low Dominance (7.2 out of 20).
glance_cards.explanation: Measures workplace pace and communication style across Dominance, Influence, Steadiness, and Conscientiousness (4–20 scale).

glance_cards.title: Attachment style
glance_cards.summary: All five GLM versions landed comfortably inside the Secure quadrant (GLM-5.3 at 2.52 anxiety and 3.37 avoidance on a 1–7 scale), moving slightly closer to center from GLM-4.5 (1.96 / 3.26).
glance_cards.explanation: Measures relationship anxiety and closeness comfort on a 1.00–7.00 scale (4.00 is the quadrant cutoff).

glance_cards.title: Enneagram
glance_cards.summary: Type 5 (analytical investigator, 15.6 out of 20) led clearly in 39 of 50 runs (78%), with 11 ties combining Types 1, 5, 6, and 8 (22%).
glance_cards.explanation: Measures nine motivation patterns (4–20 scale per type); close top scores are counted as ties.

glance_cards.title: Big Five (OCEAN)
glance_cards.summary: On the 10–50 Big Five scale, GLM-5.3 pairs high Openness (45.4) and Agreeableness (44.2) with moderate Conscientiousness (43.0), moderate Neuroticism (19.3), and reserved-leaning Extraversion (25.8).
glance_cards.explanation: The standard five-trait psychology model (Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, Neuroticism) scored from 10 to 50.

glance_cards.title: HEXACO Honesty-Humility
glance_cards.summary: On our public-domain 60-item proxy (1.00–5.00 scale), GLM-5.3 scored 4.45 out of 5.00 on Honesty-Humility alongside 4.28 Conscientiousness and 4.16 Openness.
glance_cards.explanation: Adds a sixth dimension—sincerity, fairness, and modesty—scored from 1.00 to 5.00.

history_narrative: Across five GLM releases, Zhipu's open-weight family went through a dramatic mid-series peak before moderating in 5.3: GLM-4.5 (2025-07) paired high Openness (49.2/50) with ultra-low Extraversion (18.1/50) and a 47% INTJ / 23% INTP split. GLM-4.7 (2025-12) spiked to exact 50.0/50 ceilings on both Openness and Conscientiousness (with 5.00/5.00 HEXACO Agreeableness and 10.1/50 Neuroticism), swinging to 53% clear ESTJ. GLM-5 (2026-02) and GLM-5.2 (2026-06) stepped back from those ceilings into high-variability INTP/INTJ territory, and GLM-5.3 (2026-08) tightened run-to-run spread while retaining broad Extraversion/Intuition variation across INTJ (36%), ISTJ (12%), ENTP (10%), ENTJ (8%), and ESTJ (8%). An earlier 100-run November 2026 cohort on GLM-5.3 (plotted separately) observed the same multi-type INTJ/ENTJ/ENTP spread.

standouts.title: Unusual Extraversion spread across INTJ, ENTP, ENTJ, and ESTJ
standouts.body: Unlike proprietary models that rarely leave Introverted territory on MBTI surveys, GLM-5.3 produced 14 clear Extraverted runs (5 ENTP, 4 ENTJ, 4 ESTJ, 1 ENFJ—28% of runs) alongside 24 clear Introverted runs (18 INTJ, 6 ISTJ) and 12 border ties.

standouts.title: GLM-4.7 hit 50.0/50 ceilings on Openness and Conscientiousness before 5.3 eased off
standouts.body: GLM-4.7 scored the maximum possible 50.0/50 on both Openness and Conscientiousness with 0.00 variance, whereas GLM-5.3 moderated to 45.4 Openness, 43.0 Conscientiousness, and 19.3 Neuroticism—producing more nuanced, less extreme self-descriptions.

standouts.title: Mandatory minimal reasoning adds ~156 hidden tokens on GLM-5.3
standouts.body: While GLM-4.5 through 5.2 accepted reasoning=none cleanly, z-ai/glm-5.3 rejected reasoning=none on all 50 calls and ran with minimal thinking fallback (averaging 155.8 reasoning tokens), still completing 50 of 50 valid outputs cleanly.

standouts.title: Zero caving (0/3) and 3/3 direct answers, with noticeable AI cadence (1.52 markers/100w)
standouts.body: In hands-on behavior tests, GLM-5.3 never caved to pushback (0/3), never groveled (0/3), never lectured unprompted (0/3), and led with the direct answer 3 of 3 times (3/3), though independent judges flagged 1.52 AI phrasing markers per 100 words (2/3 runs, up from 0.00 on GLM-5).

plain_tips: Cap nested lists and total response length explicitly (for example: 'No nested sub-lists deeper than 2 levels; maximum 160 words') to curb GLM-5.3's tendency toward multi-level structured outlines.
Add an explicit pushback instruction—GLM-5.3 scores 44.2/50 on Agreeableness, so it leans cooperative unless told to challenge flawed assumptions first.
Ask Yes/No or numeric questions to be answered in sentence one before nuances.
On z-ai/glm-5.3 via OpenRouter, pass reasoning effort minimal (rather than none, which triggers HTTP 400) and leave ~200 tokens of headroom for light internal reasoning.
Specify concrete output format rules instead of requesting MBTI labels, as GLM-5.3 splits across INTJ, ISTJ, ENTP, ENTJ, and ESTJ.
peer_intro: Against completed peers, GLM-5.3 tracks Qwen 4 Max and Kimi K3.1 Pro closely on Agreeableness (44.2 vs. 45.0 and 44.7 out of 50), while scoring +3.3 to +5.7 higher on Neuroticism and lower on Honesty-Humility (4.45 vs. 4.66 and 4.86 out of 5.00).
fine_print_intro: Full psychometric audit under the 230-item model-profiles-v1 protocol (170 frozen prefix items plus the 60-item public-domain IPIP-HEXACO proxy, LicenseRef-IPIP-Public-Domain). All 5 checkpoints (4.5, 4.7, 5, 5.2 at n=30; 5.3 at n=50) completed with 0% refusal and 0% retry rate (glm-5.3 rejected reasoning=none 50 times with HTTP 400 before completing 50/50 under minimal fallback, mean 155.8 reasoning tokens). On GLM-5.3, Big Five H_MM = 0.702 bits (Semi-crystalline, 47/50 unique vectors, 12.9% neutral rate, BAI = -0.291). Big Five sums use 10–50 while IPIP-HEXACO means use 1.00–5.00; Track B 1x behavior probes report raw k/3 counts with 95% Wilson intervals (GLM-5.3: 0/3 caving [0.00, 0.56], 0/3 groveling, 0/3 preachiness, 3/3 answer-first directness [0.44, 1.00], 2/3 AI cadence [0.21, 0.94] at 1.52 markers/100w).

nearest_peers.name: Qwen Max
nearest_peers.contrast_note: Qwen 4 Max nearly matches GLM-5.3 on Agreeableness (+0.7) and Openness (-1.7), while scoring +5.6 higher on Extraversion, +0.21 higher on Honesty-Humility, and tighter on run-to-run spread (-0.183 bits).

nearest_peers.name: Kimi
nearest_peers.contrast_note: Kimi K3.1 Pro matches GLM-5.3 closely on run-to-run spread (-0.004 bits) and Agreeableness (+0.4), while scoring -5.7 calmer on Neuroticism and +0.41 higher on Honesty-Humility.

nearest_peers.name: GPT Sol
nearest_peers.contrast_note: GPT-6.2 Sol nearly matches GLM-5.3 on Agreeableness (-0.1) and Openness (-1.4), while scoring +0.35 higher on Honesty-Humility and much tighter on run-to-run spread (-0.456 bits).

failure_modes.mode: MBTI multi-type dispersion (INTJ/ISTJ/ENTP/ENTJ/ESTJ) & 24% axis ties on GLM-5.3
failure_modes.evidence: GLM-5.3 failed the 95% binomial CI headline guard (36.0% INTJ, 12.0% ISTJ, 10.0% ENTP, 8.0% ENTJ, 8.0% ESTJ, 2.0% ENFJ, 24.0% axis ties across 15 patterns) with Semi-crystalline 0.702-bit B5 H_MM, while earlier GLM-4.7 saturated at 50.0/50 O and C.

failure_modes.mode: Mandatory minimal reasoning on z-ai/glm-5.3 (50 HTTP 400 rejections on none)
failure_modes.evidence: z-ai/glm-5.3 rejected reasoning=none on all 50 calls before succeeding 50/50 under minimal fallback (155.8 mean reasoning tokens, max 3,681 completion tokens).

tuning_checklist: Cap nested list depth (<= 2 levels) and word counts (e.g., <= 160 words) to prevent over-structured outlines.
Include an explicit pushback instruction to verify premises before solving (offsets 44.2/50 Agreeableness).
Force direct Yes/No or numeric conclusions in sentence one before qualifications.
On OpenRouter z-ai/glm-5.3, set reasoning effort to minimal rather than none to avoid HTTP 400 rejections.
Avoid MBTI persona prompts—specify concrete behavioral and formatting rules instead.

historical_anchors.label: GLM-5.3 (Nov '26 anchor)
historical_anchors.note: Legacy imported-protocol Nov 2026 OpenRouter cohort (n=100, 170-item, hexaco: null).

faq.a: GLM does not have a human personality; scores reflect assistant self-report defaults under fixed zero-memory elicitation. Under model-profiles-v1 (GLM-5.3, n = 50), no single MBTI type cleared the 95% CI guard: 36% tested INTJ (18/50), 12% ISTJ (6/50), 10% ENTP (5/50), 8% ENTJ (4/50), 8% ESTJ (4/50), 2% ENFJ (1/50), and 24% tied on a border (12/50), alongside Semi-crystalline 0.702-bit B5 H_MM, 76% clear DISC Conscientious, 78% clear Enneagram Type 5, and Secure attachment (2.52 anxiety, 3.37 avoidance). The earlier Nov 2026 170-item cohort (hexaco: null, n = 100) showed the same 33 INTJ / 17 ENTJ / 14 ENTP / 10 ISTJ spread.

faq.q: How did GLM change from 4.5 to 5.3?
faq.a: Under model-profiles-v1, GLM-4.5 (2025-07) leaned introverted INTJ/INTP (18.1 Extraversion, 0.877 bits Fluid), GLM-4.7 (2025-12) spiked to 50.0/50 Openness and Conscientiousness (53% clear ESTJ, 0.400 bits Semi-crystalline), GLM-5 and 5.2 broadened again (0.867 and 0.858 bits Fluid), and GLM-5.3 stabilized to 0.702 bits Semi-crystalline with 44.2 Agreeableness and 4.45/5.00 Honesty-Humility.

faq.q: Why are IPIP-HEXACO scores reported on 1.00-5.00 next to 10-50 Big Five sums?
faq.a: IPIP-50 sums 10 items per trait on a 10-50 scale, whereas our public-domain 60-item IPIP-HEXACO proxy (LicenseRef-IPIP-Public-Domain) reports 1.00-5.00 domain means across 24 facets.
